recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中一條分枝狀的顆粒，由大量圓形透明的脂肪細胞空泡、紫色梭形基質細胞與網狀基質構成，造血細胞稀疏，周圍是大片周邊血紅血球，這就是骨髓基質（stroma）的樣子。
features: Low-power view of a branching marrow particle within a blood-rich background
Numerous round clear spaces representing adipocytes embedded in the particle
Network of spindled and stellate stromal cells with purple fibrillary ground substance
Linear arrangements suggestive of small vessels/capillaries within the stroma
Relatively sparse hematopoietic cells within this particle; cellular detail limited at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a branching particle composed predominantly of stromal elements, including numerous adipocytes, spindled stromal cells, fibrillary ground substance and likely small vessels, set in a background of peripheral blood red cells. Hematopoietic cells within this particle are relatively sparse, and individual cell morphology cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings represent normal bone marrow stroma; stroma-rich particles alone should not be used to judge cellularity, which is better assessed on the trephine biopsy.

ddx.vs: Also shows fat-rich stromal particles, but the diagnosis requires consistently hypocellular particles and a trephine biopsy rather than a single stromal fragment.
Tumor fragments show cohesive sheets of large atypical epithelial or neoplastic cells rather than bland spindled stromal cells and adipocytes.
Fibrin forms fine acellular pink strands entrapping blood cells, without adipocytes or organized stromal cells.
